how.h2: Learn the complete workflow, not isolated techniques.
how.line: Every course connects design sense, software, materials and machine work, so you understand why a design succeeds, not just which button to press.
how.s1d: Read artwork the way the trade reads it: technique, density, material.
how.s2d: emCAD pathing and machine-ready files, from the first week it's relevant.
how.s3d: Frames, tension, threading: set up like a professional, not a passenger.
how.s4d: Stitch, check, fix, finish. Your hands learn what quality feels like.

coursesPage.title: Courses
coursesPage.intro: Eight live-machine courses across three families. Start where you are; the pathway below shows where each course leads.

pathway.line: Courses connect. Many students start at a machine technique, add emCAD design, and move into production or their own unit.
pathway.steps: Foundation at the machine → Core technique (Zardosi / Beads / Sequence / Coding) → emCAD design → Advanced production or your own business

admissionsPage.title: Joining is simple. Start with a free demo.
admissionsPage.sub: No online payment exists on this website. The path in is a conversation and a chair at a machine.
admissionsPage.feesBody: Fees depend on the course and batch. We share the exact fee at your demo or on WhatsApp, before you decide anything. No online payment is needed to book a demo.
handbook: Attendance is marked every session; certificate eligibility needs the attendance shown below.
Missed practicals are adjusted within your batch where possible: tell your trainer early.
Machines are shared responsibility: setup and care are part of the training.
Bring a notebook; materials for practicals are provided at the studio.
Phones on silent during machine time, for safety and focus.
Respect for trainers, students and the space is non-negotiable.
admissionsPage.eligBody: Attendance of at least 75%, completed practicals, and a finished final project reviewed by your trainer. Every certificate carries a verification QR.
admissionsPage.formNote: Takes about 2 minutes, in Gujarati or English.
